name: Validation
description: Represents data validation for a worksheet range.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AlertStyle
properties.description: Returns the validation alert style. Read-only XlDVAlertStyle.

properties.name: IgnoreBlank
properties.description: True if blank values are permitted by the range data validation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IMEMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the description of the Japanese input rules. Can be one of the XlIMEMode constants listed in the following table. Read/write Long.

properties.name: InCellDropdown
properties.description: True if data validation displays a drop-down list that contains acceptable values. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ErrorMessage
properties.description: Returns or sets the data validation error message. Read/write String.

properties.name: ErrorTitle
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the data-validation error dialog box. Read/write String.

properties.name: InputMessage
properties.description: Returns or sets the data validation input message. Read/write String.

properties.name: InputTitle
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the data-validation input dialog box. Read/write String. Limited to 32 characters.

properties.name: Formula1
properties.description: Returns the value or expression associated with the conditional format or data validation. Can be a constant value, a string value, a cell reference, or a formula. Read-only String.

properties.name: Formula2
properties.description: Returns the value or expression associated with the second part of a conditional format or data validation. Used only when the data validation conditional format Operator property is xlBetween or xlNotBetween (XlFormatConditionOperator). Can be a constant value, a string value, a cell reference, or a formula. Read-only String.

properties.name: Operator
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the operator for the data validation. See XlFormatConditionOperator.

properties.name: ShowError
properties.description: True if the data validation error message will be displayed whenever the user enters invalid data. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowInput
properties.description: True if the data validation input message will be displayed whenever the user selects a cell in the data validation range. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns a Long value containing an XlDVType constant that represents the data type validation for a range.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates if all the validation criteria are met (that is, if the range contains valid data).

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Type As XlDVType, [AlertStyle As Variant], [Operator As Variant], [Formula1 As Variant], [Formula2 As Variant])
methods.description: Adds data validation to the specified range.

parameters.name: AlertStyle
parameters.description: The validation alert style. Can be one of the following XlDVAlertStyle constants: xlValidAlertInformation, xlValidAlertStop, or xlValidAlertWarning.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description: The data validation operator. Can be one of the following XlFormatConditionOperator constants: xlBetween, xlEqual, xlGreater, xlGreaterEqual, xlLess, xlLessEqual, xlNotBetween, or xlNotEqual.

parameters.name: Formula1
parameters.description: The first part of the data validation equation. Value must not exceed 255 characters.

parameters.name: Formula2
parameters.description: The second part of the data validation equation when _Operator_ is xlBetween or xlNotBetween (otherwise, this argument is ignored).

methods.name: Modify
methods.signature: Modify([Type As Variant], [AlertStyle As Variant], [Operator As Variant], [Formula1 As Variant], [Formula2 As Variant])
methods.description: Modifies data validation for a range.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: An XlDVType value that represents the validation type.

parameters.name: AlertStyle
parameters.description: An XlDVAlertStyle value that represents the validation alert style.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description: An XlFormatConditionOperator value that represents the data validation operator.

parameters.name: Formula1
parameters.description: The first part of the data validation equation.

parameters.name: Formula2
parameters.description: The second part of the data validation equation when Operator is xlBetween or xlNotBetween; otherwise, this argument is ignored.
